div.l: A Sompnour wyth vs was in that place
That hadde a fyre reed cherubyns face
For sausfleme he was wyth eyen narow
Hoot he was and likerous as a sparow
Wyth blake browes skallid and pilled berd
Of hys vysage chyldren were a ferd
Ther nas quyksiluer litarge ne brymstone
Borace ceruse ne oyle of tartre none
Ne oynement that wold clense and byte
That hym myghte helpe of hys welkys whyte
Ne of hys knobbis sittynge on hys chekis
Wel loued he oynons garleek and lekys
And for to drynke strong wyn as red as blood
Than wold he speke ⁊and crye as he wer wood
And whan he hadde wel dronke the wyn
Than wolde he speke no word but latyn
A fewe termes hadde he two or thre
That he hadde lerned of sum man of decree
